# pizx — AI-powered shell scripting for Node.js, on cordis

> zx fork with native Pi AI integration: π (text generation), Π (coding agent), user-definable letters as cordis plugins, traceable runs with JSONL log export, and a local result cache. Write shell scripts that can reason, code, and self-improve — all from JavaScript/TypeScript.

## Quick Start

- Install: `npm install @topce/pizx`
- Docs: [README.md](https://github.com/topce/pizx#readme)

## Core Concepts

- π (pi): AI text generation via pi-ai — [docs/pi.md](https://github.com/topce/pizx/blob/main/docs/pi.md)
- Π (Pi): Coding agent with file tools (read, bash, edit, write) — [docs/capital-pi.md](https://github.com/topce/pizx/blob/main/docs/capital-pi.md)
- $: Shell commands (unchanged from zx)
- Letters: user-defined template tags as cordis plugins — [docs/extension.md](https://github.com/topce/pizx/blob/main/docs/extension.md)

## Traceability & Caching

- Trace events (letter-start, llm-call, cache-hit, …) exported as JSONL — [docs/trace.md](https://github.com/topce/pizx/blob/main/docs/trace.md)
- CLI: `pizx --trace`, `pizx --export-log`, `pizx --cache`, `pizx --letters`, `pizx --config`
- Local result cache: `.pizx/cache` (content-addressed, TTL + LRU)

## Architecture

- Onboarding & file map — [docs/onboarding.md](https://github.com/topce/pizx/blob/main/docs/onboarding.md)
- cordis plugin framework: https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis
- Pi AI: https://github.com/earendil-works/pi

## Examples

- `examples/hello-pizx.mjs` — $ + π + Π together
- `examples/basic-pi.mjs`, `examples/basic-capital-pi.mjs` — the built-ins
- `examples/custom-letter.mjs` + `examples/plugins/` — defining your own letters
- `examples/trace-and-cache.mjs` — trace export + cache hits
